Guide:
EN: Dalseo-gu district campground on Apsan's west side with caravans, auto, deck and forest sites, booked online by the month.

ID is checked at the office on entry; which foreign IDs are accepted is not stated. Weekend sites sell out quickly. Check hours and booking before visiting.

Book in your real name; bring ID such as resident card, driver's licence, passport or student card, and check in at the office. The passport example does not confirm that foreigners can complete online identity verification. Use 14:00 to noon next day; quiet 22:00-07:00; no pets, no firewood (charcoal only), no fire pits provided. Closed on Seollal and Chuseok days. Fees differ between two official pages (40,000-45,000 vs 25,000-30,000 won); check before paying.

No pets, bicycles or inline skates; no food or alcohol except a simple lunchbox and water; no commercial photo shoots. Transit per the city: Daegok Station (Line 1) exit 3 about 25 minutes on foot, or Dalseo 3/5 buses to stops 5-7 minutes away. Check hours and booking before visiting.

Booker's ID checked at the office. Quiet hours 22:00–07:00. Camping trailers and private campervans are not admitted. Check hours and booking before visiting.
